body: Note that the issue is not reproducible on Windows or Linux.

Did a super quick test on my M4 pro MacBook using the same project, I was able to reproduce on 4.7-beta1, master, _and_ 4.6.2 The editor wasn't crashing at first because I had to grand some special permissions for a Godot OpenXR Vendors plugin file to be opened, but after I granted that it started crashing.
@m4gr3d This still a releaser blocker even without being a regression?
